structured_output.summary: The reference of $465 holds. Idaho Code § 63-3024A, as amended by 2025 ch. 56, sets the food tax (grocery) credit at $155 for each taxpayer, spouse and dependent "for tax year 2025 and each year thereafter." The credit has no income limit, and any unused amount is paid as a refund, so it is refundable. The household has 3 people (the head and 2 dependent children), all eligible for 12 months, which gives 3 × $155 = $465. That is exactly what the engine computed. The cluster answer of 0 wrongly assumes the credit is nonrefundable or phases out at high income, and stage 1 correctly reached $465.
